column1: # enrichment: mypages (end-user surfaces; shareText = paste-ready line for users).

column8: Where users manage their own MFA methods; aka.ms/mfasetup lands here too.
column16: Go to https://mysignins.microsoft.com/security-info to add or change your sign-in methods.

column8: Self-service password reset for users who forgot or are locked out; needs registered methods. Users who know their password and just want a new one use the change-password page instead.
column16: Reset your password at https://passwordreset.microsoftonline.com (verify with your registered methods).

column8: Request and approve access packages; do access reviews.
column16: Request access or approve requests at https://myaccess.microsoft.com.

column8: Launcher for every app assigned to the user.
column16: Find all your work apps at https://myapps.microsoft.com.
Manage your work account at https://myaccount.microsoft.com.

column8: Self-service group join and membership management.
column16: Manage your group memberships at https://myaccount.microsoft.com/groups.

column8: Delegated password reset and phone management for frontline managers.
column16: Managers: reset your team's passwords at https://mystaff.microsoft.com.

column8: Which Office licenses and installs the user has.
column16: Check your Office licenses at https://portal.office.com/account.
Your Visual Studio benefits live at https://my.visualstudio.com.

column8: Users review their own recent sign-in activity and report anything unfamiliar; the self-service half of a compromise triage call.
column16: Review your recent sign-in activity at https://mysignins.microsoft.com and report anything you do not recognize.

column8: Users see their registered devices and can disable a lost one; BitLocker key self-recovery appears here when the tenant allows it.
column16: See and manage your registered devices at https://mydevices.microsoft.com.

column7: Security info > Add sign-in method > Passkey
column8: Users register passkeys and hardware security keys themselves on the security info page; the tenant must allow the passkey (FIDO2) method first. Phishing-resistant and the method to push over SMS.
column16: Add a passkey or security key at https://mysignins.microsoft.com/security-info: choose Add sign-in method then Passkey.

column8: For users who know their current password and want a new one; no registered methods needed. Locked-out users need the reset portal instead.
column16: Change your password at https://mysignins.microsoft.com/security-info/password/change (you need your current password; if you forgot it use the reset portal).
